title: Post-build QA fails a wrong-offering photo in an offering card and an unnamed face in a person slot, naming page, slot and photo
steps: S1: Run the host QA tests for the two slot photo checks: node --test apps/tracy-host/test/demo-qa-slot-photos.test.mjs
S2: Run the web evidence and live readiness tests: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/wo-slot-photo-evidence.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/wo-live-readiness.test.mjs
expect: S1: every test passes, among them 'a padel photo in the tennis card fails, naming the page, the slot and the photo' and 'an unnamed face in a coach slot fails both checks'.
evidence: Before this change a padel photo in the tennis card and a stranger's face in a coach frame passed every post-build check
fence: The host judge over fixture page reads, and the evidence tracy-web sends from import receipts, plan rows and brief labels
